name: Youkai Akaname no Bouken
source:
Walking into the public bath and licking dirt is the work of an akaname.
However, recently the public baths are pretty clean.There are no place that can be licked by Akaname,so he decides to invade into various public baths and directly lick the body of the girls!
translation:
走进公共浴室并舔泥土是一个别名的工作。
不过最近公共浴场倒是挺干净的，没有赤名可以舔的地方，所以他决定闯入各个公共浴场，直接舔女孩们的身体！
